Eight polynomial identities were verified by exact SymPy expansion. Endpoint/concavity arguments prove Q_A,Q13,Q23>0 for all interior parameters and hence the Wronskian ratio is strictly decreasing. Exact rational sign computations at four points force at least three stationary points for the positive counterexample. Limits, positivity, and b=sqrt(d) boundary are included. The checker does not substitute for continuous proof.

value.rationale: Uniqueness of the geometric trial-vector optimum is a directly stated difficulty in the 2026 four-period shift study. Allowing the independent middle coefficient while preserving the geometric decay is a natural structural perturbation; the proved sufficient cone includes infinitely many shifts not covered by the scalar solution. The exact positive-weight obstruction shows this property does not follow from positivity alone. The work is about lower-bound geometry and does not claim exact numerical radius or a sharp threshold.
